 Daily Tax eService Resumes Operations Ahead Of Filing Deadline
 By YGTV Newsroom 3 weeks ago The Income Tax Office has confirmed that its tax eService is back online following temporary disruption caused by service upgrades. 
 Taxpayers can now use the online service to file their returns ahead of the 30th November 2026 deadline. 
 A statement from the Government follows below: 
 The Income Tax Office wishes to advise the public that the tax eService has resumed operations and is now available for use. The service had been temporarily unavailable due to service upgrades. 
 The necessary work has now been completed, and users can once again access the eService to file their tax return online ahead of the filing date of 30 November 2026. 
 The Government appreciates the patience and understanding shown by users during the period of disruption and apologises for any inconvenience caused. 
 Taxpayers are now encouraged to make use of the online service as normal.
